Group 1: Wave Properties and Interference
This group focuses on the fundamental wave nature of light:

Wave relation (c = λf)
Wave equation (v = fλ)
Double-slit interference (d sin θ = mλ)
Single-slit diffraction (a sin θ = mλ)
Speed of light constant (c = 3 × 10^8 m/s)
Maxwell's equation (c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀))

Learning focus: Understanding wave properties, interference patterns, and the fundamental speed of light.
